note: 21 optional craft forms adapted from Jake Schincariol. Illustrative examples are not user facts or performance evidence. Choose fit over formula; verify every claim.
rules: Use only supported facts and authentic voice.
A number is optional; never invent one.
Current user intent and source fidelity outrank formulas.

hooks.name: Contrarian Take
hooks.template: Everyone says {common advice}. After {specific experience}, I think that is wrong.
hooks.example: Everyone says post daily. I posted 4x a week for a year and beat every daily poster in my niche.
hooks.best_for: A sincerely held, evidence-backed alternative view.
hooks.trap: Being contrarian about something nobody believes. The belief has to be genuinely common.
hooks.example_status: Illustrative source example, not a claim about the user.
hooks.evidence_gate: Check every event, quotation, comparison, duration and result against supplied evidence. If unsupported, choose another form.
hooks.audience_test: What can this specific reader understand, decide or do after the payoff?
hooks.variation_note: Compare against the last few project drafts; vary structure only when it helps meaning.
hooks.metrics_status: No validated performance ranking. Test in the current account with comparable observations.

hooks.name: Number Reveal
hooks.template: I {did thing} for {N} {days/weeks}. Here is what actually happened.
hooks.example: I sent 400 cold DMs in 30 days. 11 replied. 2 became clients.
hooks.best_for: A real measured experiment with a clear denominator.
hooks.trap: Burying the number. Put it in line 1 or the formula does nothing.
hooks.example_status: Illustrative source example, not a claim about the user.
hooks.evidence_gate: Check every event, quotation, comparison, duration and result against supplied evidence. If unsupported, choose another form.

hooks.name: Mistake Confession

hooks.example: $18,000 is what not having a contract cost me last March.
